title: Carolina Collection Freestanding Euro-Style Toilet Paper Stand, 27-Inch, Solid Brass | Antique Pewter | Allied Brass
body_html:
Need a toilet paper holder but don’t have the wall space—or don’t want to drill into tile? This freestanding toilet paper stand keeps a roll close at hand and stays put where you place it in Antique Pewter, which offers a soft, silvery-gray tone with subtle warmth, bridging traditional and contemporary aesthetics.

  • Antique Pewter blends effortlessly with transitional decor
  • Pairs with matching Carolina accessories for understated elegance
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Coordinated traditional look — part of the Carolina Collection for matching Carolina pieces across classic bath accessories.
  • Enduring build — crafted from solid brass materials.

Specs & Installation

  • Dimensions (L x H x W): 8 in. x 27 in. x 6 in.
  • Shipping weight: 5.6 lbs
  • Assembly: Some assembly required
  • Multiple designer finish options available
  • Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
